svg.title: Three independent checks before buying a used Aeron
svg.desc: Condition evidence, warranty provider and fit-return terms must each be checked. One does not establish the others.

g.text: A refurbished label is the start of the questions
Check these separately before you compare the checkout price.
Which chair, what work, and which parts?
Who covers defects, and what is excluded?
Can you return it if it works but does not suit you?
DeskChairDeals editorial framework · not a certification or a hands-on test
